description: This file defines the SupervisorUserRole class in the OrangeHRM system, handling user role permissions and access levels for supervisors, including access to employees, locations, and performance reviews.

classes.name: SupervisorUserRole
classes.description: A class representing a supervisor's user role within the OrangeHRM system, providing access control and permissions management for subordinate employees, locations, and reviews.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of LocationService.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Provides a list of accessible entity IDs based on entity type and required permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of employees subordinate to the current supervisor.

methods.name: getAccessibleLocationIds
methods.description: Fetches location IDs associated with subordinate employees.

methods.name: getAccessibleReviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves performance review IDs relevant to the supervisor.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns a list of quick launch options available to the supervisor.
